sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', d.date)::date AS ds, SUM(d.total_passengers) AS y FROM daily_passenger_stats d WHERE d.route_id = '107' AND TRIM(d.operator) = 'HTX-195' AND TRIM(d.vehicle_group) = '2B.1_ML' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('quarter', d.date)::date ORDER BY ds ASC;
sql_explanation: Retrieves the sum of total passengers (y) for route 107, operated by HTX-195, using vehicle group 2B.1_ML, aggregated by quarter (ds).
